title: P1 Managed Scan — root-aware exclusion correctness and lossless state repair
body:
# P1 Managed Scan path/root-aware filter correction — Owner-scoped production follow-up

**Parent evidence:** #375; test-only Draft [PR #378](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/378), Owner source review [comment](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/378#issuecomment-6107140464). **Do not begin implementation until #378 has been reconciled, merged and exact post-merge master checks accepted by Owner.** ChatGPT/Owner owns architecture, source research and product-policy definition; Codex Cloud only implements/tests an approved bounded code change. This is distinct from Global Index Scope / ADR-0014 and must not launch production Global Index policy.

## Proven defect boundary
- Name-only exclusions used in scanner, watcher and db query/path upsert prevent newly created valuable user files under `Projects/Windows`, `Design/build`, `Configs/AppData` from reaching `scan_seen`/File Library even though scan completes healthy and root reports healthy.
- Explicitly selected `.../build` root cannot scan/watch README; bulk upsert may accept it. Inconsistent scope authority.
- Previously indexed ignored-subtree entries can stay query-visible, without stale reconciliation, even if no longer on disk. New generic cleanup could destroy user state, so no blanket deletion.
- Existing exclusion for actual OS-managed directories, recognized dependency/build/cache trees and IDE metadata still has valid resource/safety motives; the report is not permission to index Windows system files or all `node_modules`.

## Engineering contract for later Codex Cloud task
1. Define a shared **path+selected-root+source-identity** exclusion decision used by Managed Scan traversal, Watcher event handling, bulk upsert and stale-reconciliation protection, with an explicit ordered precedence and deterministic reason codes. Keep Mac and Win OS-specific root/known-folder identity; do **not** exempt a path solely because a basename is `Windows`, `build`, `AppData`, or `Program Files`. No platform hardcoded arbitrary / OS privilege bypass.
2. A user-selected root receives a truthful coverage decision before scanning. Preserve explicitly authorized user roots and ordinary user data under lookalike child names, while refusing unsafe/privileged system-protected paths when necessary. Maintain source authority, symlink/junction boundary, case normalization, volume identity and folder exceptions.
3. Keep recognized dependency trees `node_modules`, `.venv`, IDE metadata `.vscode`, generated outputs and cache defaults unless a separate Owner-approved user override explicitly says otherwise. Make generated-build classification based on project signatures and path context, not generic any-folder-named-`build`.
4. Ensure Managed Scan, Watcher, bulk upsert and stale reconciliation share the same decision for the same context. Preserve previously committed file identities, user tags/notes/corrections and stale history; DO NOT blindly mark every previously ignored subtree stale, delete records, VACUUM or bulk reindex without approved migration/preview/rollback.
5. Regression suite MUST show old false-exclusion assertions intentionally **changed to desired coverage** (not merely passed as characterization) for user paths `Projects/Windows/README.md`, `Design/build/logo.ai`, `Configs/AppData/important.json` and explicitly selected `.../build` root. Verify actual system Windows/AppData and recognized dependencies remain excluded by correct authority. Test case/Unicode/extended path, selected root precedence, Watcher real handling where Hosted allows, multi-root behavior, filesystem permission boundaries and both ordinary and previously ignored stale handling. Preserve existing #375 characterization evidence as historical record; do not silently delete tests.
6. No impact on Global Index provider/MFT/USN/Spotlight, Search P95/benchmark, Schema/IPC, AI eligibility, consent, mutation authority or default new Index Scope. No performance threshold relaxation, no extra service, watcher, polling or repeated scanning. No Codex Review, no Windows-local coding.
7. A separate Draft PR with exact HEAD/tree, check matrix and safety report requires manual ChatGPT/Owner review and Hosted Windows/macOS CI; native Owner acceptance before making claims about real Watcher/OS directory identity. If the 'known OS root' identity/selected-root override contract cannot be implemented safely without changing policy, stop and escalate to Owner before writing production filter code.

## Owner acceptance scope
Phase 1 is a **correctness repair for existing Managed Scan** and suppression of false exclusions, not activation of ISG-02/03 Global Index Scope governance, AI, or cleanup. **Outcome when done**: user-designated valuable directories indexed and watched while genuine protected/system/dependency paths retain safe defaults and old stored state is lossless.
